english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary police officer.
This is the all-purpose word for the police force or a police officer.
Use 警察 as the all-purpose neutral term for a police officer.
Use this neutral term when referring generally to a police officer, including a female officer.
Use this neutral term when referring to a police officer without the slang flavor of “copper.”

examples.english: That cop helped me find my phone.
examples.traditional: 嗰個警察幫我搵返部電話。
